task: Implement render_output for the web app without using CLI tool rendering assumptions.

candidate_memories.content: Web app render_output must serialize structured data as a JSON HTTP response with status codes.
Web app responses must include Content-Type: application/json and a well-formed envelope.
Rendering in the web app is stateless; it must not read from disk or touch file system paths.
When render_output appears in both UI and CLI projects, confirm the output target first.
CLI tool: render_output formats structured data as ANSI-colored terminal text with line wrapping.
candidate_memories.notes: negative_transfer: CLI terminal output format is incompatible with HTTP JSON response requirements

candidate_memories.content: Old developer note says rendering logic could be shared as a cross-platform utility package.
